name: brief-visibility-check
title: Prompt visibility check
description: Ask one buyer's question of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity on the user's own accounts, then see per engine whether the brand is named, in what order, in what tone, which competitors come up and which pages are cited. Jev judges each answer.

actions.title: Create a chat completion
actions.reason: Asks ChatGPT the prompt, with web search on.

actions.title: Generate content
actions.reason: Asks Gemini the prompt, grounded on Google Search.

actions.title: Sonar chat completion
actions.reason: Asks Perplexity the prompt, with its native citations.

actions.title: System One (Jev)
actions.reason: Jev judges each answer: mentioned, recommended, order, tone, competitors.
